title: One item identity: every inbox reader resolves an id-less item the same way (or the host stamps the id at intake)
summary: inboxbatch.LoadFile gives an item without an id its filename stem; lifecycle.readID and triagecap.ReadInboxBacklog read the JSON id alone. Five id-less items were visible to triage, invisible to the planner and unclaimable by the lifecycle (one of them lane work). The 2026-09-27 curation stamped ids by hand; the class needs one rule. Design doc §7.7 W5.
acceptance: Every reader derives the same id for an item, or intake refuses/stamps an id-less item loudly; a test pins the three readers to one answer.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: an item visible to triage but invisible to the planner and unclaimable by the lifecycle can end a sequential cycle as a claim failure
